questions.question_text: Rotate triangle A through 90° anticlockwise about (0, 0). Label the image B.
Reflect triangle A in the y-axis. Label the image C.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle B onto triangle C.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps trapezium D onto trapezium E.
Write 260512 correct to 3 significant figures.
Write 0.000000576 in standard form.
Calculate \sqrt{27^2 - 6 \times 31^{0.3}}. Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.
Work out 37% of $820.
Work out $36 as a percentage of $150.
An amount of money is shared between Alan, Bjorn and Carlo in the ratio 3 : 7 : 5. Carlo receives $695. Find the total amount of money shared.
Carlo invests 40% of his $695 at a rate of 1.2% per year compound interest. Calculate the value of his investment at the end of 5 years.
Dana invests $2100 for 12 years at a rate of x% per year compound interest. At the end of the 12 years, the value of her investment is $2663.31. Calculate the value of x.
Write down the coordinates of the point where the line y = -2x + 3 crosses the y-axis.
Write down the gradient of the line y = -2x + 3.
The line x + y = 6 crosses the line x = -2 at point A. Find the y-coordinate of A.
Find the equation of the straight line that passes through the points (3, -1) and (12, 5).
The line L passes through the point (3, 4). Line L is perpendicular to the line 2y = 5x + 6. Find the equation of line L.
On the grid, draw the lines y = 4, x + y = 3 and y = x - 1.
By shading the unwanted regions, find and label the region R that satisfies these three inequalities: y \le 4, x + y \ge 3, y \ge x - 1.
Write down the modal class for the mass of 50 apples.
Calculate an estimate of the mean mass of the 50 apples.
Complete the cumulative frequency column in Table 2.
On the grid, draw the cumulative frequency curve to show the results in Table 2.
Use your cumulative frequency curve to estimate the median mass.
Use your cumulative frequency curve to estimate the interquartile range.
Calculate the length of AC given AB = 49 mm, BC = 91 mm, and angle B = 90°.
The diagram shows a circle with centre O and radius 16 cm. Calculate the length of the major arc AB corresponding to an angle of 305°.
The diagram shows a prism with length 12 cm. The cross-section of the prism is a quarter of a circle of radius 6 cm. Calculate the volume of the prism.

Shape ABCDE is made by joining rectangle ABDE and triangle BCD. The perpendicular height of triangle BCD is (2x + 4) cm, AB = (x + 1) cm, AE = (x - 3) cm. The total area of ABCDE is 11 cm^2. Show that 2x^2 - 3x - 20 = 0.
Factorise 2x^2 - 3x - 20.
Use your answer to part (ii) to solve the equation 2x^2 - 3x - 20 = 0.
Find the perpendicular height of triangle BCD.
y is inversely proportional to the square of x. When x = 2, y = 8. Find y in terms of x.
Find the value of y when x = 4.
Find the value of x when y = 128.
r is directly proportional to the cube of (p + 1). When p = 1, r = 16. Find the value of r when p = 4.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = g(x) where g(x) = 1 / (x - 2) for values of x between -4 and 3.
Write down the equations of the asymptotes of the graph of y = g(x).
Given h(x) = (x + 1)^2 - 3, solve the inequality g(x) > h(x).
Rani sails in a boat race around a triangular course from A to B to C and back to A. B is due north of C. The angle at C is 142°, BC = 17 km, AC = 4 km. Find the bearing Rani sails on from C to A.
Show that AB = 20.3 km, correct to 1 decimal place.
Calculate the bearing of B from A.
Rani starts the race at 08 57 and returns to A at 12 33. Calculate the average speed of her boat in km/h.

The Venn diagram shows information about 115 people who play musical instruments (flute F and drums D). F \cup D regions have frequencies 3x, x + 2, 4x + 1, and 8 outside. Calculate the number of people who play both the flute and the drums.
On the Venn diagram, shade F' \cap D.
Briony plays both the flute and the drums. Use set notation to complete the statement: Briony ... (F \cap D).
Briony has 6 red socks, 4 green socks and 8 white socks. She picks a sock at random. Find the probability that the sock is green.
Briony replaces the sock, then picks two socks at random, without replacement. Calculate the probability that the two socks are different colours.

Cone A has radius r and perpendicular height h. Cone B is mathematically similar to cone A. Solid C is formed by removing cone A from cone B. The ratio height of cone A : height of cone B = 2 : 3. Find the ratio volume of cone A : volume of solid C.
Cone A has radius 4 cm and height 10 cm. Calculate the total surface area of solid C.
Given f(x) = 3x + 1, g(x) = x^2 - 5, h(x) = 3^x, find g(3).
Find f(h(2)).
Find the value of r when f(r) = r.
Solve g(f(x)) = 20.
Find h^{-1}(x).
